title.en: Following vortex surfaces beyond ideal flow
title.zh: 越过理想流体假设，追踪真正的涡面

dek.en: A transport velocity is not necessarily the fluid velocity. The distinction improves tracking, but only under explicit existence and approximation conditions.
dek.zh: 输运涡面的速度不一定等于流体速度；这一差别能改善追踪，却必须受存在性条件与近似误差约束。

source_note.en: Source: Hao, Xiong & Yang, Journal of Fluid Mechanics 863 (2019), 513–544, DOI 10.1017/jfm.2018.1014. Full published PDF from the coauthor’s website, including Appendix A, was read; numbered figures and Table 1 were visually checked. Anchors use 1-based PDF pages. Separate online theorem proofs were not retrieved, so this is not an independent proof audit. All examples below are explanatory unless labelled simulation results.
source_note.zh: 来源：Hao、Xiong 与 Yang，Journal of Fluid Mechanics 863（2019），513–544，DOI 10.1017/jfm.2018.1014。已阅读合作者网站提供的正式全文及附录 A，并核验所有编号图与表1。页码为从1开始的 PDF 页码。独立在线定理证明未取得，因此不声称完成证明审计；下文最小例子除注明模拟结果外，均用于教学。

blocks.en: A virtual velocity preserves vortex-surface geometry where its smoothness conditions hold; controlled simulations show why physical-velocity tracking can mislead.
blocks.zh: 在光滑性条件成立时，虚拟速度可保持涡面；受控模拟揭示真实速度追踪为何会误导。

blocks.en:
### The prerequisite distinction

Imagine marking a rotating fluid with dye. A material surface follows the same fluid particles. A vortex surface instead contains the local vorticity direction everywhere: vorticity, $\boldsymbol\omega=\nabla\times\mathbf u$, measures local fluid rotation, and its integral curves are vortex lines. These are different definitions, not rival ways of detecting every possible “vortex”. A vortex-surface field (VSF) is a scalar label $\phi_v$ whose constant-value surfaces are tangent to vorticity. [§1; §3.1, PDF pp.1–4,10]
blocks.zh:
### 必要概念：粒子身份与涡面身份

设想给旋转流体染色。物质面跟随同一批流体粒子；涡面则要求处处包含局部涡量方向。涡量 $\boldsymbol\omega=\nabla\times\mathbf u$ 描述流体局部旋转，其积分曲线是涡线。这是两种定义，不是对所有“旋涡”的两套识别标准。涡面场（VSF）是标量标签 $\phi_v$，它的等值面与涡量相切。[§1；§3.1，PDF 第1–4、10页]

blocks.en:
Circulation is the line integral of velocity around a loop; by Stokes’ theorem it equals vorticity flux through a spanning surface. In ideal, inviscid, barotropic flow with conservative forces, circulation conservation makes material transport preserve vortex geometry. Viscosity, pressure–density misalignment and non-conservative forces break that implication. The paper does not erase those forces: it asks whether a different carrier velocity can absorb their effect on vorticity transport. [§2.1–2.2, PDF pp.4–6]

Before this work, virtual-velocity formulations existed, but global smooth existence was not guaranteed. The two-time VSF algorithm could enforce tangency numerically, yet still drift between different valid surfaces. The novelty is a conditional transport formulation plus concrete exact and approximate tests, rather than the invention of virtual velocity itself. [§1, PDF pp.2–3]
blocks.zh:
环量是速度沿闭合回路的线积分；由 Stokes 定理，它等于穿过回路所围曲面的涡量通量。对于无黏、正压且仅受保守力作用的理想流动，环量守恒使物质输运保持涡面几何。黏性、压力与密度梯度不对齐以及非保守力会破坏这一推论。论文没有消除这些力，而是询问：能否用另一输运速度吸收它们对涡量演化的影响？[§2.1–2.2，PDF 第4–6页]

已有研究提出过虚拟速度，但不能保证全局光滑解存在。原有双时间 VSF 算法能数值满足相切约束，却仍可能在不同合法涡面之间漂移。本文新意是有条件的输运表述与具体的精确、近似测试，而非首次提出虚拟速度。[§1，PDF 第2–3页]

blocks.en:
### Figure 2

How to read: Read the two trajectories from the same initial point. Which surface preserves particles, and which preserves vorticity flux?
blocks.zh:
### 图2

如何读：从同一起点的两条轨迹读起：哪张面保留粒子身份，哪张面保留涡量通量？

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: The red material surface follows $\mathbf u$; the blue vortex surface follows $\mathbf v$. Their separation shows why a widening vortex tube need not represent the motion of its original particles. This supports the conceptual distinction, but the drawing is a schematic, not evidence that a suitable global $\mathbf v$ exists. That existence question comes next. [Figure 2, PDF p.11]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：红色物质面随 $\mathbf u$ 运动，蓝色涡面随 $\mathbf v$ 运动。二者分离说明：涡管变宽并不必然代表原有粒子的运动。这支持概念区分，但示意图不能证明合适的全局 $\mathbf v$ 存在；下一步必须回答存在性问题。[图2，PDF 第11页]

blocks.en:
### From force to carrier velocity

Write all non-ideal acceleration terms as $\mathbf F$. Taking the curl removes conservative gradients. The goal is to choose a velocity $\mathbf v$ that reproduces the same vorticity evolution without an explicit source term. Here $\nabla\times$ is curl, and $t$ is time. [Eqs.(2.4),(2.7)–(2.8), PDF pp.4–5]
blocks.zh:
### 从非理想力构造输运速度

把非理想加速度项合记为 $\mathbf F$。取旋度会消去保守梯度项；目标是选择 $\mathbf v$，让同一涡量演化写成没有显式源项的形式。$\nabla\times$ 表示旋度，$t$ 为时间。[式(2.4)、(2.7)–(2.8)，PDF 第4–5页]

blocks.en: The drift $\mathbf v_d=\mathbf v-\mathbf u$ must satisfy $\mathbf v_d\times\boldsymbol\omega=\mathbf F+\nabla\Psi$, where the scalar gauge $\Psi$ is constrained along vortex lines. Taking a dot product gives the compatibility condition below; taking a cross product gives the normal drift. $C_\parallel$ specifies an arbitrary parallel drift because sliding along a vortex line does not change its transverse transport. $\mathbf F$ has acceleration units, $\boldsymbol\omega$ inverse-time units, so the quotient has velocity units. [Eqs.(2.21)–(2.26), PDF p.7]
blocks.zh: 漂移速度 $\mathbf v_d=\mathbf v-\mathbf u$ 必须满足 $\mathbf v_d\times\boldsymbol\omega=\mathbf F+\nabla\Psi$，其中标量规范函数 $\Psi$ 沿涡线受到约束。取点积得到下方相容条件，取叉积得到法向漂移。$C_\parallel$ 决定任意平行漂移，因为沿涡线滑动不改变横向输运。$\mathbf F$ 的量纲是加速度、$\boldsymbol\omega$ 是时间倒数，因此商的量纲确为速度。[式(2.21)–(2.26)，PDF 第7页]

blocks.en:
### Figure 1

How to read: Read force and drift as decompositions parallel and perpendicular to vorticity, not as independent physical forces.
blocks.zh:
### 图1

如何读：把力和漂移读成相对于涡量的平行、垂直分解，而非独立物理力。

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: The cross product only controls transverse drift; the parallel component is invisible to it. The diagram therefore explains the freedom in $C_\parallel$, and the gauge compensates the force component that cannot be represented by a cross product alone. It cannot guarantee global solvability of the gauge equation. [Figure 1; §2.3, PDF p.7]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：叉积只控制横向漂移，对平行分量不敏感。因此该图解释了 $C_\parallel$ 的自由度；规范函数补偿不能单由叉积表达的力分量。但该图不能保证规范方程全局可解。[图1；§2.3，PDF 第7页]

blocks.en:
A sufficient construction is $\nabla\times\mathbf F_\parallel=0$ with nonzero vorticity throughout the region swept by the tracked object, plus a compatible smooth potential. Setting the parallel drift to zero gives $\mathbf v=\mathbf u+\boldsymbol\omega\times\mathbf F_\perp/|\boldsymbol\omega|^2$. These are sufficient, not necessary, conditions: Appendix A.2 supplies an integrable counterexample to necessity. A vorticity null makes the quotient singular. Global existence and uniqueness in arbitrary three-dimensional flow are not solved. [§2.4; Appendix A.2, PDF pp.8,28]

In the controlled modified Navier–Stokes (MNS) flow, the authors remove the vorticity-parallel viscous force. This changes the physical equations and reduces enstrophy dissipation; it is an artificial test, not a more accurate real fluid. In the physical MHD case, they instead approximate the carrier while keeping the MHD solution unchanged. Mixing these two interventions would overstate the result. [§2.5; §6.2, PDF pp.9–10,21]
blocks.zh:
一个充分构造是在追踪对象扫过的区域内满足 $\nabla\times\mathbf F_\parallel=0$、涡量非零，并存在相容的光滑势函数。令平行漂移为零，得到 $\mathbf v=\mathbf u+\boldsymbol\omega\times\mathbf F_\perp/|\boldsymbol\omega|^2$。这些条件是充分而非必要条件，附录 A.2 给出可积流动反例。涡量零点使分式奇异；任意三维流动中的全局存在性与唯一性仍未解决。[§2.4；附录 A.2，PDF 第8、28页]

受控的修正 Navier–Stokes（MNS）流动删除了黏性力沿涡量方向的分量。这改变了物理方程并减弱涡量平方的耗散，是人工测试，而非更准确的真实流体。对于物理 MHD 算例，作者则保留 MHD 解，仅近似输运速度。混淆两种干预会夸大结果。[§2.5；§6.2，PDF 第9–10、21页]

blocks.en:
### A minimal example through the whole mechanism

Take the analytic two-dimensional Taylor–Green (TG) vortex, a periodic array of rotating cells. At $t=0$, $x=\pi/4$, $y=\pi/2$, Appendix A gives $\mathbf u=(0,-\sqrt2/2)$, $\omega_z=\sqrt2$ and $\mathbf v_d=(-
u,0)$. With $
u=0.1$, the carrier is $(-0.1,-0.7071)$, not $(0,-0.7071)$. First compute vorticity and diffusion; next add the outward drift; then advect a tangent scalar surface with $\mathbf v$; finally check its flux rather than simply checking where the original particles went. This is an illustrative substitution in (A1)–(A2), not a new simulation. Approaching $x=0$ makes $-
u\cot x$ diverge: the same example exposes the construction’s limit. [Appendix A.1, PDF pp.27–28]
blocks.zh:
### 用最小例子走完整条链

考虑二维 Taylor–Green（TG）解析涡，即周期排列的旋转单元。在 $t=0$、$x=\pi/4$、$y=\pi/2$，附录 A 给出 $\mathbf u=(0,-\sqrt2/2)$、$\omega_z=\sqrt2$、$\mathbf v_d=(-
u,0)$。令 $
u=0.1$，输运速度为 $(-0.1,-0.7071)$，而不是 $(0,-0.7071)$。先计算涡量与扩散，再加入向外漂移，随后用 $\mathbf v$ 输运相切的标量面，最后检查通量，而不只是原有粒子去了哪里。这是对式(A1)–(A2)的教学代入，并非新模拟。当 $x$ 接近0，$-
u\cot x$ 发散；同一个例子也暴露了方法边界。[附录 A.1，PDF 第27–28页]

blocks.en:
### Figure 15

How to read: Compare the physical streamlines, drift streamlines and their sum, left to right.
blocks.zh:
### 图15

如何读：从左至右比较真实速度流线、漂移流线及二者之和。

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: Closed physical circulation becomes outward spiral transport after the drift is added. This supports the flux-preserving interpretation: a tube can expand as its vorticity weakens. It does not mean fluid mass is created; the virtual velocity is not required to be divergence-free. The cell boundary contains singular drift, so the picture is not a global regular solution. [Figure 15, PDF p.27]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：加入漂移后，闭合的真实速度流线变成向外螺旋输运。这支持保持通量的解释：涡量减弱时，涡管截面可以扩张。它不意味着产生流体质量，因为虚拟速度不必无散。单元边界上漂移奇异，因此该图不是全局正则解。[图15，PDF 第27页]

blocks.en: The numerical pipeline starts from a VSF satisfying tangency, predicts its transport, then corrects it along frozen instantaneous vorticity in an auxiliary pseudo-time. Fifth-order WENO spatial differencing supplies dissipative regularization; time integration for the VSF uses third-order Runge–Kutta. The exact-carrier version mainly corrects numerical errors; the physical-carrier version also corrects non-ideal tangency errors. Removing the correction loses tangency; retaining it alone does not guarantee temporal identity. [§4.3, PDF pp.13–14]
blocks.zh: 数值流程从满足相切条件的 VSF 出发，先预测输运，再沿冻结的瞬时涡量在辅助伪时间中校正。五阶 WENO 空间离散提供耗散正则化，VSF 时间推进采用三阶 Runge–Kutta。精确输运速度版本主要修正数值误差；真实速度版本还须修正非理想相切误差。删除校正会失去相切性，而仅保留校正也不能保证时间上的身份一致。[§4.3，PDF 第13–14页]

blocks.en: The first condition makes each constant-$\phi_v$ surface a vortex surface; the second transports its label; the third measures tangency error (zero is perfect, absolute value one is maximally misaligned). If $\boldsymbol\omega=(0,0,2)$ and $\nabla\phi_v=(1,0,0)$, the error is zero; changing the gradient to $(0,0,1)$ gives one. This angle test cannot establish conserved flux or a unique time history. The cost of the new carrier is computing the non-ideal force, handling small denominators and justifying the omitted gauge. [Eqs.(3.1),(3.5),(4.9), PDF pp.10–11,14]
blocks.zh: 第一式让每个等值面成为涡面，第二式输运其标签，第三式测量相切误差：零为完全相切，绝对值一为最大偏离。若 $\boldsymbol\omega=(0,0,2)$、$\nabla\phi_v=(1,0,0)$，误差为零；梯度改为 $(0,0,1)$，误差为一。角度测试不能证明通量守恒或唯一时间历史。新输运速度的代价是计算非理想力、处理小分母，并证明忽略规范项的合理性。[式(3.1)、(3.5)、(4.9)，PDF 第10–11、14页]

blocks.en:
### Table 1

How to read: Read the equation column separately from the transport-velocity column: changing the flow and changing its diagnostic are not the same experiment.
blocks.zh:
### 表1

如何读：把控制方程列与输运速度列分开读：改变流动物理与改变诊断方法不是同一实验。

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: HD-NS versus HD-MNS changes the governing force. MHD-I versus MHD-IV uses the same insulating MHD dynamics but different surface transport. The latter is the fairer isolation of the tracking rule. All DNS use a periodic cube of side $2\pi$, $512^3$ grid points and $Re=100$; MHD has equal viscosity and magnetic diffusivity. Null regularization uses $\epsilon=10^{-6}$. These are low-Re, symmetry-rich tests, not a turbulence survey. [Table 1; §4, PDF pp.12–14]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：HD-NS 与 HD-MNS 改变控制方程中的力；MHD-I 与 MHD-IV 使用同一绝缘型 MHD 动力学，只改变涡面输运。因此后者更能单独检验追踪规则。DNS 均采用边长 $2\pi$ 的周期立方体、$512^3$ 网格、$Re=100$；MHD 中黏性与磁扩散率相等。零点正则化使用 $\epsilon=10^{-6}$。这些是低雷诺数、高对称算例，并非湍流普查。[表1；§4，PDF 第12–14页]

blocks.en:
### Figure 3

How to read: First compare kinetic energy, then enstrophy (mean squared rotation divided by two). Higher enstrophy does not by itself mean better tracking.
blocks.zh:
### 图3

如何读：先比较动能，再看涡量平方均值的一半，即拟涡能。拟涡能较高本身不表示追踪更好。

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: HD-MNS loses kinetic energy more slowly and retains more enstrophy than HD-NS. This supports the predicted weaker dissipation after removing a force component. It also proves why these two curves cannot serve as a pure algorithmic accuracy comparison: the underlying dynamics differ. MHD-I is a third physical system, not another implementation of the same flow. [Figure 3, PDF p.16]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：HD-MNS 动能衰减更慢，拟涡能也高于 HD-NS。这支持删除力分量后耗散减弱的理论预测，同时说明这两组曲线不能当作纯算法精度比较，因为底层动力学已改变。MHD-I 又是第三种物理系统，并非同一流动的另一实现。[图3，PDF 第16页]

blocks.en:
### Figure 4

How to read: Read the vertical axis as mean absolute tangency error; lower is better for surface validity.
blocks.zh:
### 图4

如何读：纵轴是相切误差绝对值的均值；越低表示面越符合涡面定义。

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: Both errors stay below 1% through $t=4$, with HD-MNS below 0.1%. This supports numerical tangency, not unique tracking. The paper’s approximately 10% passive-scalar comparison is a cited earlier result, not a third curve measured here. The next geometry and flux tests are therefore necessary. [Figure 4; §5.1, PDF pp.15–16]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：到 $t=4$，两者误差均低于1%，HD-MNS 低于0.1%。这支持数值相切性，但不能证明追踪唯一。文中约10%的被动标量误差来自所引前作，并不是本图重新测得的第三条曲线。因此还需要几何与通量检验。[图4；§5.1，PDF 第15–16页]

blocks.en:
### Figure 5

How to read: Compare the late modified-flow panel (c) against physical-flow panel (d), including the highlighted line connectivity.
blocks.zh:
### 图5

如何读：比较后期修正流动(c)与真实流动(d)，特别是标注区域的涡线连接。

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: The surfaces flatten in both cases, but their attached vortex lines have different connectivity near the highlighted region. This suggests that similar macroscopic surface shapes can hide different topology. It cannot establish resolved separation between surfaces: the authors explicitly say the modified-flow gap becomes smaller than the VSF grid can resolve. [Figure 5; §5.2, PDF pp.17–18]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：两种流动中的面都被压扁，但标注区域的涡线连接方式不同。这说明相似宏观外形可能隐藏不同拓扑。该图不能证明面间间隙被数值分辨：作者明确说明修正流动中的间隙缩小到 VSF 网格无法解析。[图5；§5.2，PDF 第17–18页]

blocks.en:
### Figure 6

How to read: Follow vortex-line connections around the red circle, rather than reading surface contact as automatic reconnection.
blocks.zh:
### 图6

如何读：沿红圈附近的涡线连接阅读，不要把曲面接触直接等同于重联。

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: HD-NS changes connectivity between $t=3.6$ and $3.65$ for the displayed surface, whereas HD-MNS retains nearly parallel opposing lines. This supports the conditional no-reconnection construction. It does not say all physical reconnection begins at 3.65: the integrated flux diagnostic detects changes earlier, around 2.6. Different diagnostics select different geometric regions. [Figure 6, PDF p.18]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：展示的涡面在 HD-NS 中从 $t=3.6$ 到3.65改变连接，HD-MNS 则保留近乎平行的反向涡线。这支持有条件的禁止重联构造。但不能说所有物理重联均始于3.65：积分通量约在2.6便检测到变化。不同诊断选取的几何区域并不相同。[图6，PDF 第18页]

blocks.en:
### Figure 7

How to read: Read the two orthogonal flux components together: losing one direction while gaining another is the diagnostic.
blocks.zh:
### 图7

如何读：同时读两个正交方向的通量：一个方向减少、另一个增加才是诊断重点。

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: After about $t=2.6$, HD-NS loses $\Phi_y$ and gains $\Phi_x$; HD-MNS keeps both nearly constant. This supports the interpretation that reconnection exchanges vorticity directions, whereas the modified flow preserves flux. The evidence is strong within this numerical construction, but does not prove real viscosity can be removed without changing the flow. [Figure 7, PDF p.19]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：约从 $t=2.6$ 起，HD-NS 的 $\Phi_y$ 减少而 $\Phi_x$ 增加；HD-MNS 两者近乎恒定。这支持重联交换涡量方向、修正流动保持通量的解释。在该数值构造内证据强，但不能证明删除真实黏性分量不会改变流动。[图7，PDF 第19页]

blocks.en:
### Figure 8

How to read: Use the analytically unchanged vortex-line geometry as a negative control, then examine the evolving extracted surfaces.
blocks.zh:
### 图8

如何读：把解析上不变的涡线几何作为负对照，再观察提取曲面的变化。

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: The physically transported, corrected VSF visibly deforms and appears to merge even though this special MHD field retains its vortex-line geometry. Thus small tangency error can coexist with a misleading time history. In the nondiffusive limiting case a carrier $\mathbf v=0$ removes the artefact. This does not imply every deformation in a general MHD flow is spurious. [§6.1; Figure 8, PDF pp.19–20]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：真实速度输运并校正后的 VSF 明显变形、看似合并，但这个特殊 MHD 场的涡线几何保持不变。因此，相切误差虽小，时间历史仍可能误导。在无扩散极限中，$\mathbf v=0$ 可消除该伪变形。这并不意味着一般 MHD 流动中的所有变形都是伪影。[§6.1；图8，PDF 第19–20页]

blocks.en:
### Figure 9

How to read: The left axis compares Lorentz and viscous forces; the right axis measures departure from perpendicular alignment.
blocks.zh:
### 图9

如何读：左图比较 Lorentz 力与黏性力；右图衡量偏离垂直对齐的程度。

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: The Lorentz term exceeds viscosity by at least an order of magnitude, while mean absolute alignment cosine remains below 0.25 over the studied interval. This supports using $\mathbf v\approx\mathbf u+\boldsymbol\omega\times\mathbf F_L/|\boldsymbol\omega|^2$. It does not provide a uniform error bound: averages can hide local parallel force or small-vorticity regions, and the alignment worsens with time. [Figure 9; Eq.(6.3), PDF p.21]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：Lorentz 力至少比黏性力高一个数量级；研究时段内，对齐余弦绝对值均值保持低于0.25。这支持采用 $\mathbf v\approx\mathbf u+\boldsymbol\omega\times\mathbf F_L/|\boldsymbol\omega|^2$。但它不是一致误差界：均值可隐藏局部平行力或低涡量区域，而且垂直对齐随时间变差。[图9；式(6.3)，PDF 第21页]

blocks.en:
### Figure 10

How to read: Follow the physical-carrier sequence at matched times; the protrusions near $t=1$ are the feature to test.
blocks.zh:
### 图10

如何读：按相同时刻阅读真实速度输运序列；重点检验 $t=1$ 附近伸出的细长结构。

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: Long tubular protrusions grow and later retract, while the pair remains separate at $t=2$. This establishes the physical-carrier output, not an independent ground truth. Because the same MHD dynamics underlie the next figure, comparing the two isolates diagnostic transport rather than a changed Lorentz force. [Figure 10, PDF p.22]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：细长管状突出结构先长出后缩短，到 $t=2$ 两面仍分离。这展示真实速度输运的输出，而非独立真值。下一图沿用同一 MHD 动力学，因而比较隔离的是诊断输运，而不是改变 Lorentz 力。[图10，PDF 第22页]

blocks.en:
### Figure 11

How to read: Compare each panel with Figure 10 at the same time, not with a different HD simulation.
blocks.zh:
### 图11

如何读：逐面板与图10的同一时刻比较，不要与不同的 HD 模拟混比。

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: Virtual transport removes the slender protrusions and gives flattening followed by merger. The shared physical trajectory supports attributing the visual difference to the tracking rule. However, a smoother-looking picture alone cannot establish correctness; its flux history must agree with expected pre-reconnection conservation. [Figure 11, PDF p.23]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：虚拟输运去除了细长突出结构，呈现压扁后合并。同一物理轨迹支持把视觉差别归于追踪规则。但画面更平滑本身不能证明正确，还必须检验重联前的通量守恒。[图11，PDF 第23页]

blocks.en:
### Figure 12

How to read: Compare each curve to the initial-flux dotted line before $t=1$, then interpret the later decline separately.
blocks.zh:
### 图12

如何读：先比较 $t<1$ 时曲线与初始通量虚线，再单独解释后续下降。

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: MHD-IV stays near its initial flux until about $t=1$ and then falls as surfaces reach the reconnection region. MHD-I drifts earlier and later returns upward. This is moderate-to-strong evidence for improved temporal coherence in this case, not permanent flux conservation. Preserving flux through true reconnection would contradict the physical process rather than improve the diagnostic. [Figure 12; §6.3, PDF pp.22–24]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：MHD-IV 到约 $t=1$ 保持初始通量，曲面到达重联区域后才下降；MHD-I 更早漂移，后期又回升。这对该算例的时间一致性改进提供中等至强证据，而非永久通量守恒。若真实重联过程中仍强行保持通量，反而会违背物理过程。[图12；§6.3，PDF 第22–24页]

blocks.en:
### Figure 13

How to read: Read the thick virtual-carrier contours against thin physical-carrier contours and the signed vorticity background.
blocks.zh:
### 图13

如何读：比较粗的虚拟速度轮廓、细的真实速度轮廓与带符号涡量背景。

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: The virtual contours approach and flatten earlier and better follow intensifying vorticity regions. This provides a spatial explanation for Figure 12’s flux advantage; it cannot make the approximate velocity exact. The paper contains an apparent repeated case label in the discussion, so the interpretation here follows the caption and directly inspected contours. [Figure 13, PDF pp.23–24]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：虚拟速度轮廓更早靠近、压扁，并更贴合涡量增强区域。这为空间上解释图12的通量优势提供支持，但不能令近似速度变为精确速度。原文讨论存在疑似重复的算例标签，因此此处依据图注和直接核验的轮廓解释。[图13，PDF 第23–24页]

blocks.en:
### Figure 14

How to read: Read the spiral streamlines together with the signed horizontal drift and the two surface contours.
blocks.zh:
### 图14

如何读：把螺旋流线、带符号的水平漂移及两类曲面轮廓一起阅读。

blocks.en: Key observation, why this supports the interpretation, and limitations: The virtual flow sweeps surfaces outward faster, explaining earlier approach to symmetry planes. This supports a geometric transport mechanism rather than a new physical acceleration of fluid particles. It does not independently establish the authors’ extrapolation to higher-Re transition or inviscid singularities, which were not simulated here. [Figure 14, PDF p.25]
blocks.zh: 关键观察、为何支持该解释及其边界：虚拟流动更快地把曲面向外输运，解释了其更早接近对称面。这支持几何输运机制，而非流体粒子受到新的真实加速度。它不能独立证实作者对高雷诺数转捩或无黏奇性的推测，这些情形并未在本文模拟。[图14，PDF 第25页]

blocks.en:
### Contribution and next tests

The strongest contribution is separating instantaneous tangency, temporal coherence and genuine topology change. Exact transport in a modified dissipative system provides a controlled reference; approximate transport in an unchanged physical system demonstrates practical diagnostic value. The general existence theorem and general turbulence applicability remain open, and the separate proof supplement was not audited here.

A concrete future test is to vary the null regularization $\epsilon$ and grid resolution together while measuring flux error before contact; this would distinguish robust transport from regularization-dependent apparent topology. A second is to compare the omitted-gauge approximation against a numerically solved compatible gauge as force–vorticity alignment deteriorates. Neither test should be replaced by selecting prettier surfaces. [§4.4; §7, PDF pp.15,25–26]
blocks.zh:
### 贡献与下一步验证

最强贡献是区分瞬时相切、时间一致性与真实拓扑变化。修正耗散系统中的精确输运提供受控参照；不改变物理系统的近似输运展示诊断价值。一般存在性与一般湍流适用性仍开放，本文也未审计独立证明补充材料。

一个具体后续实验是联合改变零点正则化 $\epsilon$ 与网格分辨率，测量接触前的通量误差，以区分稳健输运与依赖正则化的表观拓扑。另一个实验是在力与涡量垂直关系变差时，把忽略规范项的近似与数值求解相容规范的结果比较。这两项都不能由挑选更好看的曲面替代。[§4.4；§7，PDF 第15、25–26页]

blocks.en: **Final judgment: a useful conditional diagnostic framework.** The force-to-carrier construction explains how vortex geometry may move differently from fluid particles. The steady-field negative control and pre-reconnection flux comparison are more persuasive than visual smoothness alone. The method neither restores ideal-fluid physics universally nor tracks a uniquely identifiable line through every reconnection. Use it where its smoothness, null handling and approximation conditions can be checked.
blocks.zh: **最终判断：值得借鉴的有条件诊断框架。** 从力到输运速度的构造解释了涡面几何为何不同于粒子运动。稳态场负对照与重联前通量比较，比视觉平滑性更有说服力。它既不普遍恢复理想流体物理，也不保证每次重联中都能唯一追踪同一涡线。应用前必须检查光滑性、零点处理与近似条件。
